items.title: Strategy's Brief Return to Bitcoin Buying
points: Strategy resumed its pause on Bitcoin purchases after just one week, reversing its earlier buying signal to markets.
Instead of accumulating BTC, the firm deployed $176.3 million into repurchasing its own preferred stock (ownership shares with priority claims).
Strategy also doubled authorization for its digital credit securities buyback program to $2 billion, suggesting capital allocation priorities shifted away from direct crypto holdings.

items.title: Bitmine's Ethereum Accumulation Continues
points: Tom Lee's Bitmine purchased $70 million in additional Ethereum over the past week.
Bitmine now holds 5.93 million ETH, representing approximately 4.9% of Ethereum's total circulating supply—a significant concentration.
Majority of Bitmine's Ethereum is staked (locked in consensus mechanisms to earn rewards), indicating a long-term holding strategy rather than trading.

items.title: Zondacrypto Exchange Collapse
points: Polish authorities detained a fifth suspect in connection with the Zondacrypto exchange investigation.
Two chief executives have disappeared from the exchange four years apart, suggesting a pattern of leadership fleeing amid issues.
1.3 million clients remain locked out of their funds held on the platform.

items.title: Robinhood-Crypto.com Partnership
points: Robinhood took an equity stake in Crypto.com as part of a multi-year infrastructure deal.
Crypto.com will serve as the clearing engine and infrastructure backbone for Robinhood's prediction markets business (speculative betting platforms on event outcomes), its fastest-growing segment.

items.title: Liquid Network Hack Partially Reversed
points: Hackers returned $270 million in Bitcoin after stealing $320 million from Liquid Network.
Nearly 600 BTC remains outstanding following Blockstream's patched security fix.
